conflicts.problem: Lessons 3 and 4 both teach the same concentration investigation (same dilutions, same cross method). Lesson 3 says 'the same collision theory we used to explain temperature in Lesson 1', but temperature was never explained in Lesson 1. Lesson 4 says 'same as Lesson 3' for particle SPEED, but Lesson 3 is concentration. Lesson 5 then calls temperature 'Lesson 3' and concentration 'Lesson 4'. The lessons disagree on which lesson covers which factor, and there is no dedicated temperature lesson even though Lesson 8 refers to thiosulfate cross times at four temperatures.

Lesson 6 (catalysts and light, with liver/H2O2) and Lesson 7 (catalysts and light, with MnO2 and photographic paper) duplicate the same content. Lesson 6 is titled 'Factor 4' and Lesson 7 'the final rate factors'. Lesson 8 counts only 'four rate factors' and omits light, while Lessons 6 and 7 count five.

Lesson 2 says the learners calculated rate values 'from Lesson 1 data', but Lesson 1 recorded no timed data, only approximate times. Lesson 2 also runs the experiment at room temperature only, yet it claims temperature was 'confirmed' as a variable.
